cardDescriptor: A £230 sticker. More aerodynamic advantage than a wind-tunnel-tested bicycle. Purely by manipulation of local atmospheric reality.
panelDescription: The Infocigan Aero Sticker V1. 76×71mm. Less than 1.5mm thick. £230. Operates on aesthetic superiority and hubris. 50 units. Belief > Drag.
